# sutramx_maintenance_windows (Data Source)

Maintenance windows of the workspace, newest start first. Read-only: creating or changing a window silences alerts, so the API only allows it from the workspace owner's dashboard session, not with API keys. Works with any API key, including read-only keys.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Maintenance windows are created in the dashboard by the workspace owner;
# Terraform can read them.
data "sutramx_maintenance_windows" "ongoing" {
  effective_status = "ongoing"
}

output "in_maintenance" {
  value = length(data.sutramx_maintenance_windows.ongoing.windows) > 0
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `effective_status` (String) Only windows in this live state: `scheduled`, `ongoing`, `completed` or `cancelled`.

### Read-Only

- `ids` (List of String) Ids of the returned windows, in order.
- `windows` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--windows))

<a id="nestedatt--windows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `windows`

Read-Only:

- `affected_services` (List of String)
- `description` (String)
- `effective_status` (String) Status computed from the current time (the stored status can lag behind).
- `end_time` (String) RFC 3339 end time (UTC).
- `group_ids` (List of String) Monitor groups covered when `scope_type` is `group`.
- `id` (String)
- `impact` (String) `low`, `medium` or `high`.
- `monitor_ids` (List of String) Monitors covered when `scope_type` is `monitor`.
- `recurrence_type` (String) `none`, `daily` or `weekly`.
- `recurrence_until` (String) Last day a recurring window repeats; null when it repeats indefinitely or does not recur.
- `recurrence_weekdays` (List of Number) Weekly windows: days of the week (0 = Sunday).
- `scope_type` (String) `global` (every monitor), `monitor` or `group`.
- `start_time` (String) RFC 3339 start time (UTC).
- `status` (String) Stored status: `scheduled`, `ongoing`, `completed` or `cancelled`.
- `timezone` (String) IANA time zone the window was scheduled in.
- `title` (String)
